title: Animals and People
seo_title: Grade 2 Science: Animals and People Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe ways animals help people and how people affect animals and their homes; identify ways to care for animals and their habitats. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand B: Life Systems – Growth and Changes in Animals)
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 science worksheets on how animals help us, caring for pets and wild animals, and protecting animal homes, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: People and animals need each other.
key_sub: Animals give us food and help; we must care for pets and protect animal homes.
body_html:
How to think about it

Animals help people, and people can help animals.

  • Bees help plants; dogs help people.
  • Pets need food, water and care.
  • Keep animal homes clean and safe.
Example

Which animal gives us wool?

it says baa

Answer: a sheep

Example

How can you help birds in winter?

food is hard to find

Answer: fill a bird feeder

Common mistakes

  • Thinking wild animals make good pets.
  • Thinking litter does not hurt animals.
